title: Silicon Valley is falling in line with Trump’s attempt to rename AI
slides: Tech giants quietly accept Trump's AI rebranding. Why?
The rename reshapes how Washington funds research priorities.
Some engineers call it propaganda, yet comply to keep contracts.
Your AI tools may carry new political labels soon.
Ask vendors what the name change means for you.
thread_text:
1. The Quiet Rebrand

Tech giants are quietly accepting Trump's AI rebranding. The rename directly reshapes how Washington funds research priorities.

2. Money Talks

Federal AI grants now follow the new branding. Labs that resist risk losing billions in contracts.

3. Silent Engineers

Some engineers call it propaganda but comply to keep contracts. Internal pushback stays behind closed doors.

4. Your Tools Changed

AI tools you use daily may soon carry political labels. The branding shift reaches consumer products.

5. Ask Before You Buy

Ask vendors what the name change means for you. If they can't explain it, question the tool.
